about: The Internet Security POV policy. Every rule gets the POV prefix, the POV rule label and the zpov:<pov-id> stamp, and applies only to the customer's pilot group. Categories, DLP engines and Cloud App Control actions are checked against the tenant during discovery; anything the tenant lacks is left out with a note in the change list. Names stay within ZIA's 31 characters including the prefix. Starting values come from the AI Guard SE Demo Kit's ZIA template (checked against a live tenant, Oct 2026).

ssl_inspection.name: Bypass finance and health
ssl_inspection.why: Listed first so it sits above the inspect rule.

ssl_inspection.name: Inspect pilot group
ssl_inspection.why: EICAR over HTTPS, DLP and Cloud App Control only work on decrypted traffic.

customer_actions.name: Malware Protection blocks viruses and unwanted apps
customer_actions.why: Malware and Advanced Threat Protection are tenant-wide policies the customer owns, so the kit never changes them.
